title: Commitment Reduction for the Expiring Term, Residential Electricity Supply Renewals
content:
**Clause.** A renewing Residential Electricity Supply agreement receives a commitment reduction on the renewal rate according to the length of the term that is expiring. The expiring term is counted in months from the later of the service start date and the latest renewal or plan change date through the contract end date, the end month included: the whole months between the two dates, plus one for the end month. For an expiring term of 24 months or more the long-commitment reduction of 0.20 cents per kWh applies, for 12 to 23 months the mid-commitment reduction of 0.10 cents per kWh applies, and for a shorter term none applies. An agreement with no contract end date has no expiring term and receives none.

**Counting examples (hypothetical agreements).**

| Term counted from | Contract end date | Whole months between | End month included | Expiring term | Commitment reduction |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| service start 2024-06-01, no later renewal or plan change | 2026-05-31 | 23 | yes | 24 | 0.20 cents |
| plan change 2025-04-01 | 2026-03-31 | 11 | yes | 12 | 0.10 cents |
| renewal 2025-12-01 | 2026-05-31 | 5 | yes | 6 | none |
| service start 2024-05-15 | 2026-05-14 | 23 | yes | 24 | 0.20 cents |
| month-to-month, no end date | none | none | none | none | none |

**Boundaries.** An expiring term of 24 months takes 0.20 cents and one of 23 months takes 0.10 cents; 12 months takes 0.10 cents and 11 months takes none.
